items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: Von Freeman, Chico Freeman, George Freeman, they're all from the Freeman family.

ctx.x: Von Freeman, Chico Freeman, George Freeman, they're all from the Freeman family. Well, Bruz I think is the oldest Freeman brother. He went out to California to live, after leaving Sarah, and I think I've seen him once or twice then. I don't even know whether he's playing drums at all now. But his brothers are very popular musicians these days, and very good ones, I understand.

But this formed Sarah Vaughan's first trio. I guess for about eight or nine months, we had maybe... .No, not eight or nine months. For almost a year, up until Christmas week of 1953, which I guess would probably be at least ten months that we worked together...
